usage: telegram-tools invite [-h] {list,create,revoke} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,create,revoke}
    list                Your invite links to a chat, shown in full
    create              Make a new invite link and show it once (y/N)
    revoke              Revoke an invite link (y/N); the link is redacted
                        everywhere but the flag

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
